Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 29/06/2026 to 27/07/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17402
- Various opportunities available
- Remuneration packages - $78,000 - $175,000
- Join the team at Westforce Construction

Westforce Construction was originally established in 2006, primarily as a Civil Construction Contractor. Since then the company has grown and diversified into a multi-disciplined Contractor venturing into structural steel fabrication, precast concrete panel fabrication and erection, high and low voltage electrical installation, and the design and construct of civil works and commercial buildings.

We are currently looking to fill the following roles:

Mechanical Engineering Technician (Pipelines) - To be considered for this position, you must have a minimum of 5 years' industry experience as a QA /QC Inspector or equivalent on pipeline related works. You must hold the associated NDT Certifications. Your primary focus will be on NDT Testing and Welding Inspection. This is a FIFO Role (planned as 2:1 - must be flexible) working within the mining environment.

Drainer / Plumber - To be considered for this position, you must have a minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role and be confident with all aspects of drainage and plumbing in the commercial sector.

Formwork Carpenter - To be considered for this position, you must have a minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role and be confident performing physical tasks related to heavy construction projects.

Motor Mechanic - To be considered for this position, you will need to be trade qualified as a Motor Mechanic and have a minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role.

Diesel Motor Mechanic - To be considered for this position, you will need to be trade qualified as a Diesel Motor Mechanic and have a minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role.

Construction Project Manager - To be considered for this position, you will need to have a minimum 3 years' experience as a Project Manager. A degree or trade qualification is highly desirable.

Occupational Health and Safety Officer - To be considered for this position, you will need to have a minimum of 3 years' experience in an Occupational Health and Safety Officer role.

Quantity Surveyor - You will be responsible for estimating and monitoring construction costs from the project handover stage through the construction period and beyond. To be considered for this position, you will need to be degree qualified in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or similar, with a minimum of 3 years experience in a similar role.

Office Manager - To be considered for this position, you will need to have a minimum of 3 years' experience in an Office Manager role. You will be responsible for the organisation and control of functions and resources of the office.

Civil Engineer - To be considered for this position, you must have a minimum of 3 years experience as a Civil Engineer. Your role as Engineer will be to plan, design, organise and oversee the construction and operations of projects.

Fitter - To be considered for this position, you will need to be trade qualified and have a minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role.

Construction Estimator - To be considered for this position, you will need to be trade qualified and have a minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role.

Contract Administrator - You will manage the commercial and contractual aspects of civil construction projects from contract award through to project completion. You will work closely with Project Managers, Site Engineers, clients, consultants, subcontractors and suppliers to ensure contracts are administered efficiently, risks are managed, and project objectives are achieved. To be considered for this position, you are required to have 3 years work experience in similar role.

Other valuable skills and attributes include:
 -High standards of workmanship
- Attention to detail
 -The ability to work unsupervised and in a team environment
 -An honest and reliable work ethic
- Clear communication skills

Salary packages between $78,000 to $175,000 will be negotiated with the successful candidates and will be aligned with your level of experience.

If you think you have the skills and background we're looking for, APPLY NOW and fill in the online application form - https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17402.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right person.
